headers.im: Judith cabu he lamhma cuek kah Hebrew ol la a tael dae Bible cungnueh (canon) dongah thum sak uh pawh a ti. AD 397 Carthage Council tunpuei neh, AD 1549 Trent tunpuei ah tah canon dongah a hlum uh. Judith dongah he Antiokus Epiphanes (175-164 BC) tue vaengkah khosaknah kawng tueng. Te vaengah he bang catael he muep muep om. He cabu long tah Palestine kah Jews rhoek taengah a rhal te oel ham neh Pathen olkhueng dongah uepom la om ham a a thaphoh. Rhainah meyet om mai cakhaw thincak thin-om lah Pathen olkhueng dongah pai ham te a thui.

verses.text: \s1 Arpakshad loh Ecbatana A Dum
He tah Nebukhadnezzar kah ram a kung hlainit vaengah om. Anih tah Assyria kah khopuei tanglue Nineveh ah manghai. Te vaengah tue Arpakshad khaw Mede Ecbtana ah manghai van.
Anih loh Ecbataba kaepvai kah vongtung te dong thum aka thah tih thongrhuk aka sen lung rhaih neh a sak. Vongtung te dong sawmrhih a sang neh, dong sawmnga a ka la a saii.
Vongka kah rhaloengim te a sang dong yakhat neh a khoengim te dong sawmrhuk lo.
A vongka te dong sawmrhih sang tih a ka dong dong sawmrhuk lo. Te dongah caemtloek la aka cet caempuei caempa khaw muep ael rhoeh.
Te vaengah manghai Nebukhadnezzar loh manghai Arpakshad te Ragau korhi la van a len ah a vathoh thil.

Teah te tlang khohmuen kah pilnam boeih khaw, Euphares, Tigris neh Hydaspes kah khosa boeih khaw, kolvan kah Elymean manghai Ariockh khaw anih taengla khong uh. Te dongah namtom rhoek tah Chalden caem taengla muep om uh.   
\s1 Nebukhadnezzar loh Ultimatum

Assyria manghai Nebukhadnezzar loh puencawn rhoek te, Persia kah kaha khosa rhoek taengah khaw, khotlak kah aka om boeih taengah khaw, Cilicia, Damasku, Lebanon, Antilebanon kah khosa rhoek taengah khaw, tuikaeng kah kho saengah khaw,
Gelead Karmel kah namom taengah khaw, a so Galilee neh Esdraelon kolvan puei ah khaw,
Samaria neh a khopuei rhoek ah khaw, Jordan rhalvanga hil khaw, Jerusalem neh Bethany ah khaw, Chelous nehKadesh ah khaw, Egypt tuiva ah khaw, Tahpanhes nek Raamses, Gpshen khohmuen pum ah khaw,
Tanis neh Memphis voelah khaw, Egypt khosa boeih neh Ethiopia khori due khaw a tueih.

Tedae khorhi boeih kah Assyria manghai Nebukhadnezzar loh a khue te a aal uh. Anih taengah caemtloek la caeh te ngaih uh pawh. Anih te a rhih uh moenih. Tedae anih te hlang pakhat van boeiloeih lamni a poek uh. Te dongah puencawn rhoek te kuttling neh yahtoe la a tueih uh.

Te dongah Nebukhadnezzar tah a khorhi kah boeih taengah a thintoek te sai. Te dongah Cilicia khorhi boeih khaw, Damasku neh Syria khaw tawnloh hamla, Moab khohmuen kah boeih boeih, Ammon pilnam khaw, Judea boeih, Egypt booeih khaw, tuitunli rhoi, tuikaeng hil khaw cunghang neh ngawn ham ol a hlo.   
\s1 Arpakshad Yawk
Kum hlai rhih dongah a tah manghai Arpakshad te caem neh a paan. Te dongah caemtloek vaengah anih yawk. Te vaengah Arpakshad kah caem khaw, lambong khaw, leng khaw boeih a palet pah.
A khopuei kah khoyo te a loh te Ecbataba duela a pha. A hmuensang te a loh pah, a hnoyoih hmuen khaw a poelyoe pah, thangpomnah te khaw yahpohnah la a khueh pah.
Arpakshad te khaw Ragau tlang ah a tuuk tih caai neh a daeng. Te dogah anih te bangtlang boeih a phae.
Te phoeiah ah tah Nineveh la mael tih a caempuei neh a lambong pum te koep a cului. Te vaengah a caempuei duem tih hnin ya hninkul khuiah ah kho a tue uh.
Kum hlairhet nah, hla khat hnin kul hnin nit vaengah Assyria manghai Nebukhadnezzar im ah ram tom soah tawnlohnah a khuen te, a thui tangtae bangla koep a thui.
A mangpa boeih neh a boei boeih te te a khue tih a hmai ah a ngol sak. Te vaengah a huep la cainah khaw, halang khohmuen kawng te khaw a hmuilai neh a hah la a thui.
Te dongah anih ol aka ngai pawt boeih te tah phae hamla ol a tloek uh.
A mangtaengnah te a coeng phoeiah tah Assyria manghai Nebukhanezzar loh amah hnukthoi, amah caem kah rhalboei Hlophernes te a khue.

Te vaengah anih te, “Diklai pum kah boei, manghai boei loh he ni a thui. Ka mikhmuh lamloh nong lamtah a thadueng na uepnah hlang te khuen. Kho neh aka cer rhalkap te thawng ya pakul saeh lamtah, hnopuei te thawng hlai nit saeh.
Khotlak kah khohmuen te boeih paan uh laeh. Amih te ka olpaek a ngai uh moenih.
Diklai neh tui a rhoekbah ham khaw amih te thui pah. Amih te ka thintoek ne ka paan coeng. Diklai hman boeih te ka caem kah kholaeh neh ka et pawn ni. Amih te poelyoe ham ka tloeng pawn ni.
Soklong neh tangrhom tangbue khaw amih rhok loh a et vetih tuiva ah amih duekrhok bae ni.
Amih te diklai khobawt hil tamna la ka sol pawn ni.
Cet uh lamtah amih kah ram boeih te kai hmai ah ana lo uh laeh. Amih te amah ah nangmih taengla ha yalh uh bitni. Amih dantanah hnin duela amih te ana tuu uh.
Nangmih aka mah rhoek te khaw rhen boeh. Amih te maeh aka ngawn kut ah tloeng uh lamtah a khorhi kah boeih te tah poelyoe uh.
Ka ram kah thaomnah neh ka hing dongah, ka thui coeng te tah ka kut neh ka coeng sak ni.

Nangmih khaw na boeipa kah olpaek te poe pawt ham ngaithuen, kai loh nang kanguen te buelh saii, uelh muehla saii laeh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.   
\s1 Holophernes Tingtunnah
Te dongah Holophernes tah a boei mikhmuh lamloh nong. Te phoeiah rhalboei rhoek, caemtloek boei, neh Assyria caem kah rhoiboei boeih te a khue.
Caem te a loh tih a soep phoeiah tah a boei soh saii sak ham a uen bangla a boel. Te vaengah amih te thawng ya paul loh tih marhang hnuk ah lii aka pom he thawng hlainit lo.
Anih loh a cului rhoek boeih te muep yet tih camuepuei caempa la om.
Te phoeiah kalauk khaw, hnophuei muli-marhang neh khaw, taelek na pawh saelhung neh boiva khaw, cakok khaw muep a tung.
Caemtloek rhoek loh lampu khaw a cung la a dang uh tih, sui neh cak khaw manghai thakvok dong lamkah muep a dang uh.
Te dongah a caemtloek boeih te manghai Nebukhadnezzar kah a hmai ah a caeh sak ham diklai hmai boeih ah leng khaw, marhang caem khaw, lipom rhoek te lampu aka phuei rhalkap khaw a yaal.
Amih hmatoeng ah namcom caempuei te kaisih bangla, diklai hmankah laipi bangla toeklek toekna pawt hil cet uh.
Nineveh lamloh Bectileth kol hil he hnin thum cet uh tih a so Cilicia kah tlangpuei tlang kah Bectileth ah rhaeh uh.
Te phoeiah Holofernes loh a caem khaw, leng khaw, marhang caem khaw, a rhalkap boeih te a khuen tih tlang ram la luei uh.
Anih long te Put neh Lud a thup phoei Chellean ram tuithim kah, khosoek rhi, Rassis neh Ishamale te khaw a poel a yoe.
Te phoeiah Perath te a vai tih Messopotamia khaw a poeng. Abron solong kah hmuencak khopuei rhoek neh tuitunli duela a paeh.
Cilicia khorhi duela a loh tih anih aka mah boeih te khaw a ngawn. Arabia imdan kah Japheth khorhi tuithim duela cet.
Median pum te a dum tih a dap te a hlup pah phoeiah a tuping khaw a poelyoe pah.

Yenthaih cangah tue vaengah tah Damasku kol la cet bal tih loh te boeih a hlup pah. A saelhung khaw, boiva khaw a thup pah tih a khopuei rhoek te a hinghoek pah. A khohmuen te a thup pah tih, tongpa cadong boeih te tumca dongah a kaeh pah.

Te dongah anih te tuikaeng kah khosa pilnam boeih long khaw, Sidon neh Tyer kah long khaw, Sur neh Ocina khaw khosa rhoek long khaw, Jamia kah khosa boeih long khaw a rhih uh tih thuen uh. Azotus neh Askalon kah khosa rhoek long khaw anih te lutlut a rhih uh.
Te dongah anih taengla rhoepnah saii hamla he ol he a tah uh tih,
“Manghai boei Nebukhadnezzar kah sal rhoek tah na taengah ka kuep uh coeng. Na ngaih bang boeih la kaimih taengah saii mai.
Ka im neh ka khohmuen boeih khaw, cang lo boeih khaw, ka saelhung neh ka boiva boeih khaw, ka rhuengim boeih khaw na hmaiah om coeng. Te rhoek te na ngaihnah bangla sai mai.
Ka khopuei rhoek neh a vangca boeih khaw na sal pai ni. Halo lamtah amih te na hmuh bangla saii mai,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.
Hlang rhoek khaw Holofernes taengla cet uh tih he he boeih a thui uh.
Te dongah a caem neh tuipuei kaeng la suntla. Te dongah rhalmah khaw a khueh khopuei khaw a cak la sai, rhakap a thapnah hlang te khaw a coelh.
Pilnam neh khokaep boei long khaw a nih te rhaihulh neh, lam neh, kamrhing neh a doe uh.

Tedae amih kah cangimphu boeih a phae pah tih a rhobuk khaw a vung pah. Khohmuen pathen rhoek boeih te boeih phae tih thup hamla laipai a tueih. Namtom boeih loh Nebukhadnezzar bueng te bawk saeh lamtah koca takuem neh ol cungkuem loh anih te pathen la n'khue saeh a ti.
Te vaengah Judea kong puei rhaldan kah, Dothan taeng, Esdraelon taeng khaw a pha.
Geba neh Scythopolis laklo ah rhaeh dae a caem hamla lampu a vawtnah rhuet loh hla khat puet om.
\s1 Judea Rhalrhingnah

Te vaengah Judea kah khosa Israel ca rhoek loh Assyria manghai Nebuchadnezzar kah rhalboei Holofernes loh namtom taengah a saii te khaw, a bawkim tom a phae pah tih a metla a poelyoe pa te khaw a yaak uh coeng.
Te dongah amih khaw, anih loh ham paan ham te mat thuen uh. Te dongah Jerusalem ham neh a Pathen Boeipa im ham te rhalrhing la om uh.
Amih khaw vangsawn lamloh paipaek uh pueng tih Judea kah pilnam boeih neh huek humcui uh. Te dongah tuisi-am neh hmueihtuk khaw, a bawk im khaw a tihnai khui lamloh a ciim uh.
Te dongah ol te Samaria paeng la, Kona, Bethhoron, Belmain neh Jerikho la, Khoba neh Aesora la, Salem kol la a pat uh.
Tlang som boeih te koe a hul uh tih a vangca te a thung uh. Caemtloeknah hamla caak te khaw a tuung uh. Te vaengah amih lorhing cang boeih khoem a ah coeng.
Te vaeng tue kah Jerusalem ah khosoih ham la aka om Joakim loh Bethulia neh Betomesthaim kah pilnam ham ca a pat. Te tah Dathan kaep kah kol Esdraelon rhaldan ah om.

Amih te tlang naeng te hul hamla a uen. Te lamkah te amih loh Judea te a muk thai dongah. Te ah aka kun boeih te khoep mah hamla yoei ca. Te kah naeng te caek ka hlek tih va a ael vaengah hlang panit ni a ael rhoeh.   
\s1 Thangthuinah neh Yaehnah
Jerusalem kah ngoltunnah dongah Israel ca rhoek neh a hamca rhoek long khaw khosoih ham Joakim loh amih a uen vanbangla a saii uh.
Israel hlang boeih te Pathen taengah a tloh la bungbung pang uh. Te vaengah amamih khaw yaehnah neh kunyun uh.
Amamih neh a yuu rhoek khaw, a ca rhoek khaw, a im kah yinlai boeih khaw, kutcoep boeih khaw, a hlang lai rhoek khaw, a pumpu ah tlamhni boeih a vaep uh.
Israel hlang tah tongpa khaw, huta khaw, camoe khaw Jerusalem kah rhoek tah amamih te bawkim hmaiah bakop uh. Boeipa mikhmuh ah tlamhni a bai uh tiah a lu dongah hmaiphu a phul uh.

Hmueituk te tlamhni neh a khuk uh tih huekhuek pang uh. A ca rhoek a loh pah pawt ham neh a yuu rhoek te kutbuem la a khuen pawt ham, rhokso te a tihnai pawt ham, namtom kah nueihbu nueihkam la om pawt ham te Pathen taengah ngaelngael thangthui uh.
Pilnam he Judea pum neh Jerusalem kah Tlungthang Boeipa rhokso hmaiah khaw khoyin a sen a yaeh uh dongah, Boeipa loh amih kah thangthuinah neh a yaak tih amih phacipphabaem te khaw a hmuhming pah.

Khosoih ham Joakim neh Boeipa hmaiah aka pai khosoi rhoek khaw Boeipa taengah thotat uh. A pumpum te tlamhni a bai uh hnin takuem hmaihlutnah hmueih khaw, paelnaeh hmueih khaw, pilnam kah moeihoeih hmueih khaw a hlut pah.
Israel imkhui te a kolonah neh sawt ham amah kah saithainah boeih neh, a lupong sokah hmaiphu neh Boeipa taengah pang uh.

Israel pilnam loh caemtloek hamla rhuengphong uh tih, tlang naeng khoep a buk uh te khaw, tlang som boeih a tung uh tih kol ah rhalmah a khueh uh te khaw Assyria caem kah rhalboei Holofernes taengah a thui pah.
Te dongah thintoek kalh la Moab mangpa rhoek neh Ammon rhalboei rhoe khaw, tuipuei kaeng kah khoboei boeih khaw tun a khue.

Te phoeiah amih te, “Nangmih Kannan rhoek kai taengah thui uh lah, hekah tlang ram ah mebang pilnam nim aka om? Mebang khopuei nim a om nah? A caem khaw metlam a len tih, a thadueng neh thaomnah metlam a khueh? Amih soah mebang manghai ni aka boei tih a caem khaw u long a mawt?

Khotlak kah khosa boeih loh balae tih amamih bueng a buel uh? Kai taengah lo ham neh hum uh ham khaw a aal u van rhailai.   
\s1 Achior kah Ol

Te vaengah Ammon boeih kah mawtkung Achior loh anih te, “Ka boeipa aw, na sal ka dong lamkah ol he hnatun mai dae. Na kaepvai tlang ram kah kho aka sak pilnam kawng he oltak la namah taengah kan thui eh. Na sal ka lamloh a hong a om moenih.
He pilnam he Khaldean koca lamkah rhoek ni.
Amih tah Mesopotamia ah thikat la om dae a napa rhoek a om nah Mesopotamia kah sungrhai te bawk hamla huem uh pawh.

A napa rhoek kah longpuei a toeng parhi te vaan Pathen ni a bawk uh. Pathen a ming dongah amih te a napa rhoek amamih kah sungrhai mikhmuh lamkah a haek uh. Te dongah Mesopotamia la yong uh tih kum a sen kho a sak uh.
A Pathen loh amih te a om nah khohmuen caeh tak tih Kannan khohmuen paan hamla a thui pah. Kho a sak uh vaengah sui khaw, cak khaw, rhamsa khaw muep pung tih, muep rhoeng uh tih boei uh.
Khokha he Kannan khohmuen ah a tlung vaengah, Egypt la suntla uh. Te dongah caak a om khuiah tah kho a sak uh. Amih te hlangping la muep rhoeng tih a namtu tae lek pawh.
Te dongah Egypt manghai khaw amih taengah tlung coeng. Amih te a phaep tih thanuei la laiboeng a saii sak uh.
A Pathen te a khue uh dongah Egypt khohmuen te lucik thae neh a ngawn pah. Te dongah amih te Egypt loh a mikhmuh lamkah a haek.
Pathen loh amih mikhmuh ah Carhaek Tuili khaw a kak sak coeng.
Amih te Sinai neh Kadesh-barnea longpuei ah a mawt. Amih loh khosoek pilnam khaw boeih a haek uh.
Amori khohmuen kah imhmuen te a loh uh a tlungnah neh Heshbon kah khosa boeih khaw a thup uh. Jordan te kat uh tih tlang ram kah khuehtawn khaw a loh uh.
A mikhmuh lamloh Kannan khaw, Perizze khaw, Jebusi, Shechemi neh Gergesi boeih khaw, a haek tih kum a sen kho a sak uh.
A Pathen taengah a tholh uh pawt khuiah tah amih khaw rhoeng uh. Boethae aka thinah Pathen he amih taengah ni a om.

Tedae amih hamla a khueh pah longpuei lamloh a nong uh vaengah tah, amih te caem neh a heh tih khlong khohmuen ah tamna la a khuen. A Pathen kah bawkim he diklai la rhawp tih a khopuei tah a thunka loh a hul pah.
Tedae a Pathen taengla mael uh coeng a taekyaknah hmuen lamloh bal uh coeng. Te dongah a rhokso a om nah Jerusalem a loh uh. Imrhong la aka om tlang khomuen ah kho a sak uh.
Te dongah ka boeipa aw, pilnam he sawtkoi kaw om mai pueng khaming, a Pathen taengah a tholh atah a boethae khaw m'hmu khaming. Te daengah ni n'cet uh thai vetih a yawk uh eh.

Tedae namtu te boethae a om pawt atah, ka boeipa loh amih te rhael mai laeh. A Boeipa neh Pathen loh amih a rhun hae vetih, mamih tah diklai pum kah nueihbu la n'om hae ni,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.
Achior kah ol a thui he a khah vaengah dap taengkah aka pai pilnam khaw kohuet uh. Holofernes boei rhoek neh tuikaeng kah khosa boeih khaw, Moab loh maehpoel la a sah ham khaw a pai thil loh,
“Israel ca te rhih hamla a om moenih, amih he a pilnam khaw caemtloek la aka saii thadueng neh thaomnah a om moenih.
Boei Holofernes aw lamhma la cet uh sih, nang kah caempuei caempa loh amih te a payawk bitni,” a ti uh.
\s1 Israel te Achior kut ah A Tloeng
Tingtunnah kawtpoeng kah pilnam loh kholawknah a saii te a daeh phoeiah tah Assyria rhalboei Holofernes loh Achior te kholong hlanglang boeih kah mikhmuh ah,

U nang nim, Achior nang he Ephraim kah hlang vat a? Tihnin ah kaimih taengah na tonghma mai. Israel pilnam taengah caemtloeknah saii pawt ham neh amih te Pathen loh a thingthung ni tila na thui mai? Nebukhadnezzar phoeiah he pathen tloe om bal nim? A caempuei te a tueih vael amih te diklai hman lamloh a phae pawn ni he. A Pathen loh amih te khang kek pawh.
Mamih manghai kah tueiyoeih rhoek loh amih te hlang pakhat bang lamni m'pae mai eh. Mamih kah lambong thadueng he oel uh thai mahpawh.

Amih te n'hlawp vetih a tlang long khaw a thii ni a ok eh. Te vaengah a khohmuen ah a rhok khawk bae ni. Mamih loh n'tloek vaengah a khopha pataeng loeih pawt vetih bitbit milh uh ni. Te dongah ni diklai pum kah boei, manghai Nebuchadnezzar long khaw a thui. A ol he pakhat khaw yoe mahpawh.
Ammon hlangvat Achior nang loh ol he khungrhap la na thui. Te dongah tihnin kah Egypt lamloh aka yong koca rhoek phu hlan atah ka maelhmai na hmu mah pawh.
Ka cunghang neh, ka caem neh, ka cai neh ka mael vaengah ka tueihyoei rhoek loh na vae han thun bitni. Te vaengah amih kah rhok neh na yalh bitni.
Ka tueiyoeih rhoek loh nang te tlang la n'khuen pawn saeh lamtah puei caeh long kah tlang naeng ah n'khueh saeh.
Amih neh a poci hlan hil ngawn tah na duek mueh mahpawh.
Amih te yawk mahpawh tila na ngaiuep pueng a tah na kothae maelhmai te khaw khue a ngoe voel moenih. Ka thui coeng he, ka ol he hloo pawt vetih oltak la om ni,” a ti.
Te phoeiah tah Holofernes a dap khuiah anih aka tawt rhoek te, Achior tuk ham khaw, anih te Bethulia la khuen tih Israel ca taengah paek ham khaw ol a paek.
Te dongah sal rhoek loh anih te a tuuk phoeiah kol kah rhaehhmuen la a khuen uh. Kol lamloh tlang hmuen la luei uh tih Bethulia hmuikah sok te a pha uh.
Khopuei hlang rhoek loh a hmuh vaengah pumcumnah a pom uh tih khopuei lamloh tlang la luei uh. Te vaengah payai aka pom rhoek long khaw amih te a mah tih lungto neh a dae uh.
Te dongah tlang hmui te hlipyingnah la a khueh uh. Te phoeiah Achior neh a pin uh tih tlang yung ah a yalh sak uh daengah a boei taengla mael uh.
Israel ca rhoek te a khopuei lamloh a suntlak uh vaengah tah anih te a hmuh uh. Te dongah anih te a hlam uh tih a khopuei boei rhoek kah mikhmuh ah a tloeng uh.
Te khohnin kah Simeon koca kah Mikah capa Uzziah, Gothoniel capa Chabris neh Melchiel capa Charmis khaw om.
Amih loh khopuei kah patong rhoek te boeih a khue tih a ca huta tongpa khaw tingtunnah la yong uh. Achior te a pilnam lakli ah a khueh uh tih metla ol a om khaw Uzziah loh anih te a dawt.
Anih long khaw a hlat tih Holofernes kah ngoltunah dongah aka thoeng te khaw, Assyria mawtkung rhoek mikhmuh a cal boeih te khaw, Israel imkhui soah Holofernes a hoemdam boeih te khaw a thui pah.

Te vaengah, “Vaan kah Pathe ka Boeipa aw, amih kah mangkhaknah khaw hmu lamtah pilnam kah a tlayaehnah he lungma ti mai laeh, na taengah a cim la aka rhoek taengah he na maelhmai tueng sak laem lah,” tila pang uh.
Te phoeiah Achior te a uem uh tih a sang la a koeh uh.
Uzziah loh anih rhaengpuei taeng lamloh a loh tih amah im la a khuen. A ham rhoek ham khaw buhkoknah a saii tih khoyin puet bomnah bih ham Israel Pathen te a khue uh.
\s1 Bethulia a Dum Uh
A vuen ah tah Holofernes loh a caem boeih neh anih taengla aka kap huitai boeih te, rhaehhmuen lamloh paek uh tih Bethulia thoeih ham, tlang naeng te loh Israel soah caemtloeknah khueh ham ol a paek.

Te dongah a caemtloek rhoek khaw khong uh. Te vaengah rhalkap thawng yakhat, marhang caem thawng halinit, hnophuei rhamsa neh te te aka dawn rhoei, a kho neh a hnuk aka vai rhoek neh caempuei caempa la cet uh.
Amih te Bethulia kol kah sok taengah rhaeh uh tih Dothan ah te Balbaim duela yaal uh. A sen loh Esdrealon rhaldan kah Bethulia lamoh Cyamon duela a pha.

Israel ca rhoek loh hangmi te muep a hmuh vaengah tah lakueng neh thuen uh. Te dongah a hui taengah khaw, “Khohmuen pum he boeih a hlih uh pawn ni. Tlang sang khaw, tuikol khaw, mol khaw a rhih te noeng mahpawh,” a ti uh.
A pumcumnah te rhip a pom uh tih hmaithoi hmai neh khoyin khing a tawt uh.

“Ka boeipa aw, kaimih kah ka thui he hnatun lah, na caem long hmatanah khaw yook mahpawh.

He kah tui ni Bethulia kah pilnam pum loh a than. Tui a halh uh vaengah amih te n'thup vetih a khopuei te khaw han tloeng bitni. Kaimih khaw ka pilnam neh mol la noenoe ka luei uh saeh lamtah khopuei lamloh pakhat khaw a coe thai pawt ham tlang hlaep lamloh kan dawn eh.

\s1 Israel ca kah Kothaenah

Tedae Uzziah loh amih te, “Kamanuca rhoek neh ka ngannu rhoek, namning sak uh. Hnin nga mah rhing dae sih. Te khohnin ah mamih Boeipa Pathen loh mamih taengah rhennah a tueng sak bitni. Amah loh mamih he n'hnoo tangkik aih mah pawh.

A im kah imphu ah amah hamla dap hloep a tuk tih. A pumpum ah tlamhni a bai tih nuhmai himbai te a yil.

Tuemsomnah neh Pathen a hinyah dongah anih a thae la aka thui om pawh.

Amih te a pha vaengah tah a taengah,  
 Bethulia kah pilnam mawtkung rhoek kai ol he hnatun uh lah. Balae tih pilnam taengah oltak na thui uh pawh. Pathen neh nammih laklo ah khaw olhlonah na phoei uh tih na toemngam uh bal. Khohnin te yet te mamih bomkung neh Boeipa ha pawt pawt atah khopuei he tloeng ham ol na khueh bal.

Hnin nga khuiah mamih bomnah ham khueh pawt mai cakhaw a ngaih tue vaengah amaih hoeptlang ham thadueng a khueh maco.

Mah huiko aka ngawn rhoek khaw, khohmuen aka lo rhoek khaw, mah rho aka pong sak khaw, namtom lakli ah tah mamih lu ah ni a tlak eh. Te ah sal m'bi uh tih mamih aka tu kah mikhmuh atah boethae neh rhaidaeng la n'om pawn ni.

Amih taengah a saii bangla mamih he hmai neh n'noem moenih ta. Amih thinko a khe vaenngkah bangla mamih soah phutlohnah a khueh aih moenih ta,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.

Nang tah Pathen aka rhih nu la na om pai, te dongah Boeipa loh rhotui han tueih saeh lamtah tuito he han koei saeh. Te vaengah tuihalh loh n'koek khaw m'ming voel mahpawh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.

Te phoeiah Judith amah te bakop tih a lu dongah hmaiphu a phul. Tlamhnin a bai te khaw a pit. Jerusalem Pathen im kah hlaemvang bo-ul nawn tue buel a pha vaengah tah Judith te Boeipa taengah ol a len la pang.

Aka cat lamhma neh aka hnuk aka vai hno he khaw namah loh na saii coeng. Aka om coeng neh aka lo ham hno khaw na hmoel coeng. Na lungbuei aka te tah thoeng tangloeng coeng.

Na thadueng tah hlangmi dongah hangdang pawt tih, na tlungnah khaw thaomnah a hangdang moenih. Tedae namah tah tlayae rhoek kah Pathen, hlanghnaep kah bomkung, thahoeng aka duelkung, a hno rhoek aka tungaepkung, ngaidaeng rhoek kah khangkung la na om.

\s1 Judith loh Holofernes a paan
Judith loh Israel Pathen taengah a pang te khaw a toeng tih a ol he khaw boeih coeng.

A pum dongah tlam hni a pai te khaw a dul tih, nuhmai hni te khaw a pit. A pum te tui neh a silh hluksi a phu aka tlo neh amah hluk uh. A sam te a soh tih samkhuem te a khuem. A va Manasseh a hing vaengah a bai noek, poei himbai te a pum dongah a bai.

A kho dongkah khokhom khaw, khocin khaw, oihnun khaw, kutbuen khaw, hnathawn neh a lungvang boeih khaw a buen. Amah te a then koek lah phuekhlak uh tih anih aka hmuh tongpa boeih kah a mik te hlat a loh pah.

A taengah na pai vaengah khaw na thinko ah rhihnah khueh boeh. Tedae na om bangla a taengah thui ngawn, nang te a then la n'toi bitni.

\s1 Judith te Holofernes taengla a Khuen
Te phoeiah Holofernes aka tawt neh a tueihyoeih boeih te ha nong tih anih te dap khuila a khuen uh.

Holofernes loh anih te, “Huta nu aw, namning sak lamtah na lungbuei ah rhihnah khueh boeh. Diklai pum kah manghai Nebukhadezzar aka bongyong boeih tah u khaw nganboh ka pae mahpawh.
Tahae ah khaw, tlang kah khosa boeih loh kai he m'veet pawt atah amih taengah ka cai he ka thueng mahpawh. He amamih longni a saii uh.
Kai taengah thui lah, amih taeng lamloh na yong tih kaimih taengla na lo he balae tih? Tahae ah tah hiluepnah khuila na lo coeng. Namning sak tihnin hlaem lamloh a voelvai hil khaw na hing bitni.

Nang te nganboh m'pae mahpawh. Nang tah ka boei manghai Nebukhadnezzar kah sal rhoek loh a saii bangla nang te a then lamni n'toi eh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.   
\s1 Judith loh a thui Pah
Judith loh anih te, “Na sal kah ol he doe mai lamtah na sal loh na mikhmuh ah thui mai saeh. Tahae hlaem ah khaw ka boeipa taengah a hong ka thui mahpawh.
Na sal kah ol he na vai koinih Pathen loh nang dongah pakhat khaw a soep sak ni. Ka boeipa kah mangtaengah te thaihtak ham khaw hloo mahpawh.

Diklai pum kah manghai Nebukhadnezzar kah hingnah rhangneh, a thaomnah long ni mulhing boeih hoihaeng hamla nang n'tueih. Nang rhangneh hlang hing bueng loh amah te bong pawt tih, khohong rhamsa neh saelhung khaw, khohli dongkah vaa khaw hing. Nebukhadnezzar hmui kah neh a imkhui pum khaw nang rhangnen ni a om.
Na cueihnah neh na thoemthainah khaw ka yaak uh coeng. Te te diklai pum ah thang coeng. Ram pum ah khaw namah bueng ni na then. Caemtloeknah a longim dongah na khuet koek tila thang tangkik coeng.
